canonical.heading: Amazon Bedrock announces reduced pricing for OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol
canonical.summary: Today, OpenAI announced that they are lowering API prices for GPT-5.6 Sol. Following the recent Terra and Luna price reductions, Sol now costs $4 per million input tokens and $20 per million output tokens—20% lower input pricing and 33.3% lower output pricing. canonical.heading: Launching External Web Access for Web Search on Amazon Bedrock
canonical.summary: Earlier this month, we announced Web Search on Amazon Bedrock , a built-in server-side tool that allows you to ground model responses with current web knowledge, while maintaining data within your secured AWS environment with zero data egress. Today, we are expanding Web Search to enable the external_web_access parameter allowing Web Search to retrieve content directly from the public web so model

canonical.heading: AWS Cost Anomaly Detection supports third-party models on Amazon Bedrock
canonical.summary: AWS Cost Anomaly Detection now monitors spend on third-party foundation models running on Amazon Bedrock, such as Anthropic Claude and other provider-hosted models. canonical.heading: Amazon Bedrock now supports SpaceXAI Grok 4.6 with Cross Region Inferencing
canonical.summary: Amazon Bedrock now supports SpaceXAI Grok 4.6, a frontier model built for coding, agentic tasks, and knowledge work, with US Geo and Global cross-Region inference. canonical.summary: Amazon Bedrock now supports the OpenAI GPT-5.6 models (Terra and Luna) in India, with India Geo cross-Region inference. Customers with regulatory requirements of in-country inferencing can now use OpenAI models at scale ensuring that inferencing is processed within India.
